title: A Hardy space approximation supporting zero-free half-planes for the $ζ$-function
summary: An equivalent version of the Báez-Duarte criterion \cite{baez} for the Riemann Hypothesis (RH) by Bagchi states that the RH holds true if and only if the function $E(s) = 1/s$ belongs to the closed linear span of $G_k(s) = (k^{-s} - k^{-1})ζ(s)/s,\, k \geq 2$ in the Hardy space \( H^2(\mathbb{C}_{1/2}) \), where $\mathbb{C}_α$ denotes the half-plane $\mathrm{Re}(s)>α$. We first show that if $E$ belongs to the closure of span$(G_k)_{k\geq 2}$ in \( H^2(\mathbb{C}_α) \) for $α>1/2$, then $ζ$ is zero-free in $\mathbb{C}_α$.
